```yaml
name: Nuitka Linux Build

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install system dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential

      - name: Install Python dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install nuitka

      - name: Determine Nuitka output name
        run: |
          if [[ "$RUNNER_OS" == "Linux" ]]; then
            echo "OUTPUT_NAME=dirsearch" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          else
            echo "OUTPUT_NAME=dirsearch.exe" >> $GITHUB_ENV
          fi

      - name: Build with Nuitka
        run: |
          mkdir -p build
          nuitka \
            --standalone \
            --onefile \
            --output-dir=build \
            --output-filename=${{ env.OUTPUT_NAME }} \
            dirsearch.py

      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: dirsearch-linux
          path: build/${{ env.OUTPUT_NAME }}
```
